scope: Bounded PG1012 public-source reading and provenance verification, not native original-record or empirical acceptance

checks.check: All5saved browser capture bytes and SHA256 match preserved receipts
checks.meaning: Capture preservation only, not authentication of historical contents

checks.check: Two diagnostic crops separate from originals, source hashes unchanged
checks.meaning: NEAREST visible-pixel legibility, no inferred or hidden content

checks.check: Actual rendered control/footer/date/field transcription read against three selected pages
checks.meaning: No adopted loading views, whole-file/corpus claim or native byte equivalence

checks.check: Existing73page text-index locator for four literal terms
checks.meaning: Limited index result, not proof the records do not exist

checks.result: Same official form / unrelated collision; no underlying input

checks.check: One observed official root-object ordinary HTTP read
checks.meaning: Viewer remains accessible; no source PDF body/hash or motive inference

not_performed: Proof of intent, source fabrication, suppression, wrongdoing or conspiracy
publication_verification: Not performed by candidate builder; actual commit/push/ref/all-file evidence saved separately after review
